title: The Name Before
summary: The word is a name: the Chariot's name, from before the cult gave him another. A Believer's House would have it written somewhere, under the prayers. Find it, and find out why nobody says it.

goals.say: Scratched into the floor under the Preacher's mat: the same angles. And a second line beneath them.
It takes you all night. 'He who speaks the name gives it back.'
'So that's why they pray in angles,' the elder says. 'Not to keep from offending him. To keep from feeding him.'
goals.name: Village Elder

threats.name: Village Elder
threats.target_line: You found it, didn't you. Whatever it was. Sit down. Don't say it.
talk: Every time it's said, he gets a piece back.
Then we'll not say it. Not here, not ever. Burn the book if you have to.
The cult never says it either.
Of course they don't. You don't feed a dog you're trying to keep hungry.
